Design a focused implementation plan to fix UI/UX issues in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.widget.tsx` (~1600 lines). This is a Shopify Polaris v13 admin page. ## User complaints: 1. First 2-3 cards (Layout + Widget Style) feel "weird" — jumping/shape-changing when clicking 2. Right side preview column is too small in height 3. Wants full Polaris compliance — sharp, no lagging ## Audit findings (prioritized): ### CRITICAL: Layout selector border jumping (lines 926, 954, 982) The 3 position selector buttons use conditional border: `1px` when unselected → `2px` when selected. This 1px difference causes visible layout shift. **Fix**: Always use `2px` border, change COLOR only: - Unselected: `border: "2px solid transparent"` (or `"2px solid var(--p-color-border-secondary)"`) - Selected: `border: "2px solid var(--p-color-border-emphasis)"` Also add missing Space key handler (only Enter is handled currently), and add `aria-pressed` attribute. ### HIGH: Right side preview column too small (line 1505) ```jsx
...preview...
``` Preview is sticky but has no minimum height. When widget style changes (e.g., popup), it can feel cramped. **Fix**: - Set `minHeight: "500px"` on the preview Box - Better: use Polaris `Box` instead of raw `
` for the sticky wrapper - Consider making the preview area taller with `minHeight` on the Box wrapping WidgetPreview ### HIGH: Custom divs in Layout position selector (lines 918-1000) The 3 position option tiles are raw `
` with 30+ lines of inline styles each. **Fix**: Extract a small `PositionOption` component or simplify with consistent Polaris Box patterns. Key changes: - Use consistent 2px border (no jumping) - Add Space key support alongside Enter - Add `aria-pressed` for accessibility - Replace inline SVGs with cleaner approach ### MEDIUM: Color pickers using raw `` (lines 1116-1260) 5 raw HTML color inputs. These work but aren't Polaris-styled. **Fix**: Wrap each in a Polaris-consistent way using `Box` with border tokens. Keep the native `` (there's no Polaris ColorPicker for hex), but style it with Polaris tokens. ### MEDIUM: Performance — WidgetPreview re-renders on every keystroke `WidgetPreview` is defined outside the component (good) but receives a `previewCfg` object that's recreated on every render. **Fix**: - Wrap WidgetPreview with `React.memo` - Memoize `previewCfg` with `useMemo` - Memoize the CSS string inside WidgetPreview with `useMemo` ### LOW: Custom `
` wrappers (lines 1309-1326) Used around TextFields in the Text Content card. **Fix**: Wrap with Polaris `Box` and use `width="50%"` or just keep the div (it's minimal and functional). ### LOW: Mini preview divs use inline styles (lines 1039-1093) The mini-previews inside the Tabs are intentionally visual mock-ups. These are fine as inline-styled divs since they're just decorative thumbnails, not interactive components. **Skip**: Leave mini-previews as-is. They're non-interactive decorations. ## Constraints: - Only modify `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` - Must use Polaris v13 components from existing imports: Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, InlineGrid, Text, Button, TextField, Select, Checkbox, Divider, Box, Banner, Badge, Modal, Tabs - Must pass `npm run typecheck` - Don't break any existing functionality (save, preview, style switching, position changing) ## Questions to address in plan: 1. Should we replace the position selector divs with Polaris `Button` with `pressed` prop, or keep custom divs but fix the border? 2. For the preview height, should we set a fixed minHeight or make it responsive? 3. Should we memoize the WidgetPreview component? Please provide a step-by-step implementation plan with exact line ranges and code patterns.

The file is `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.widget.tsx` (1601 lines, Polaris v13.9.5). --- ### Answering the Design Questions First **Q1: Should we replace position selector divs with Polaris `Button` with `pressed` prop, or keep custom divs but fix the border?** Keep custom divs but fix the border. Rationale: Polaris `Button` does not support the visual layout needed here (SVG icon + label stacked vertically in a tile). The existing pattern is a visual tile selector, not a standard button. The fix is simple (constant 2px border, change color only) and adding `aria-pressed` plus Space key makes it accessibility-compliant. Extracting a reusable `PositionTile` component reduces the code from ~90 lines of repetition to ~30 lines of component + 3 invocations. **Q2: For the preview height, should we set a fixed minHeight or make it responsive?** Use a fixed `minHeight: "500px"` on the Box wrapping the WidgetPreview content (line 1546). This ensures the preview never feels cramped, especially when the position is "popup" (which renders more content). The sticky wrapper should remain so the preview follows scroll. Polaris `Box` supports `minHeight` as a prop (confirmed used in `app._index.tsx` line 416), so we can replace the raw `
` with ``. **Q3: Should we memoize the WidgetPreview component?** Yes. `WidgetPreview` is a pure function of `cfg` and `previewState`, but the `previewCfg` object on line 839-845 is recreated every render (new reference each time), so `React.memo` alone would be defeated. The plan is: 1. Wrap `WidgetPreview` with `React.memo` 2. Memoize `previewCfg` with `useMemo` keyed on all its constituent state values 3. Memoize the CSS string inside `WidgetPreview` with `useMemo` This stops the entire CSS recalculation + DOM diff on every keystroke in any text field that does not affect the preview (like changing `errorMessage` when preview is in `idle` state). --- ### Step-by-Step Implementation #### Step 1: Add `useMemo` and `React.memo` imports (line 1) Change: ```typescript import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from "react"; ``` To: ```typescript import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, memo } from "react"; ``` This follows the pattern in `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx` line 1 which already imports `useMemo`. --- #### Step 2: CRITICAL FIX -- Eliminate border jumping in position selector (lines 918-1000) **Root cause**: Lines 926, 954, 982 use `1px solid` when unselected and `2px solid` when selected. The 1px difference causes a layout shift of 1px on each side (2px total height/width change) on every click. **Extract a `PositionTile` component** to be defined between `WidgetPreview` (ends line 660) and `WidgetPage` (starts line 663). Insert around line 662: ```typescript const PositionTile = memo(function PositionTile({ value, label, selected, disabled, onSelect, children, }: { value: string; label: string; selected: boolean; disabled: boolean; onSelect: (v: string) => void; children: React.ReactNode; }) { return (
!disabled && onSelect(value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if ((e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") && !disabled) { e.preventDefault(); onSelect(value); } }} style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100, border: selected ? "2px solid var(--p-color-border-emphasis)" : "2px solid var(--p-color-border-secondary)", borderRadius: 10, padding: "12px 10px", cursor: disabled ? "not-allowed" : "pointer", background: selected ? "var(--p-color-bg-surface-selected)" : "var(--p-color-bg-surface)", textAlign: "center" as const, opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : 1, transition: "border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease", outline: "none", }} > {children} {label}
); }); ``` Key changes from the current code: - **Border always `2px`**: `"2px solid var(--p-color-border-secondary)"` when unselected (was `1px`). This eliminates the layout shift entirely. - **`aria-pressed={selected}`** added for accessibility. - **Space key handler** added alongside Enter (`e.key === " "`), with `e.preventDefault()` to stop page scroll. - **`transition` narrowed** to only `border-color` and `background` (was `all`). Prevents unintended animation of padding/margin changes. Then replace lines 916-1001 (the three `
` blocks and the wrapping ``) with: ```tsx ``` This reduces ~85 lines of repetitive inline-styled divs to a clean ~35-line usage block plus a reusable component. --- #### Step 3: HIGH -- Fix preview column height and replace raw div (line 1505) **Current code** (lines 1505-1560): ```tsx

The value `"500px"` ensures the preview area has enough vertical space for popup/floating layouts that render more content than inline. --- #### Step 4: MEDIUM -- Style color picker inputs with Polaris tokens (lines 1116-1260) There are 5 `` elements. Change: ```typescript } ``` To: ```typescript }); ``` **5b: Memoize the CSS string inside WidgetPreview** (line 409) Change: ```typescript const css = buildWidgetCss(wid, cfg); ``` To: ```typescript const css = useMemo(() => buildWidgetCss(wid, cfg), [wid, cfg]); ``` Note: Since `cfg` is an object, this memo will only help when paired with 5c (memoizing `previewCfg` so the reference is stable). **5c: Memoize `previewCfg` in WidgetPage** (lines 839-845) Change: ```typescript const previewCfg: WidgetConfig = { position, primaryColor, successColor, errorColor, backgroundColor, textColor, heading, placeholder, buttonText, successMessage, errorMessage, notFoundMessage, showEta, showZone, showWaitlistOnFailure, showCod, showReturnPolicy, showCutoffTime, showDeliveryDays, blockCartOnInvalid, blockCheckoutInCart, showSocialProof, borderRadius, widgetStyle, customCss, }; ``` To: ```typescript const previewCfg: WidgetConfig = useMemo(() => ({ position, primaryColor, successColor, errorColor, backgroundColor, textColor, heading, placeholder, buttonText, successMessage, errorMessage, notFoundMessage, showEta, showZone, showWaitlistOnFailure, showCod, showReturnPolicy, showCutoffTime, showDeliveryDays, blockCartOnInvalid, blockCheckoutInCart, showSocialProof, borderRadius, widgetStyle, customCss, }), [ position, primaryColor, successColor, errorColor, backgroundColor, textColor, heading, placeholder, buttonText, successMessage, errorMessage, notFoundMessage, showEta, showZone, showWaitlistOnFailure, showCod, showReturnPolicy, showCutoffTime, showDeliveryDays, blockCartOnInvalid, blockCheckoutInCart, showSocialProof, borderRadius, widgetStyle, customCss, ]); ``` This ensures the `previewCfg` object reference stays stable when none of its constituent values change, which in turn lets `React.memo` on `WidgetPreview` actually skip re-renders. --- #### Step 6: LOW -- Replace flex:1 wrappers in Text Content card (lines 1309-1326) **Current**: ```tsx
